data/blackvein/blackvein.kyr:
Module blackvein "Bells Under Blackvein" {
  Description "Blackvein lives on mine wages. Lord Vey's agent promises a safe road in exchange for the mine's revenue. The reopened workings ring at night; one miner has not come home. Explore, examine what you find, and decide whose claims deserve your help. Travel and work each cost a watch; people and dangers act while you are elsewhere.".
  Entity party: group "Your company".
  Entity ada: group "Ada Flint, miners' forewoman".
  Entity vey: group "Ser Caldus, Lord Vey's agent".
  Entity iven: group "Brother Iven, keeper of the well".
  Entity len: group "Len Wren, pump tender".
  Entity echo: group "The listening echo".
  Entity road: place "South road". Entity square: place "Weighbridge square".
  Entity inn: place "The Bent Pick inn". Entity guild: place "Merchants' countinghouse".
  Entity shrine: place "Well shrine". Entity toll: place "North road checkpoint".
  Entity ridge: place "Heather ridge". Entity mine: place "Blackvein minehead".
  Entity shaft: place "Old pumping gallery". Entity vault: place "Buried bell chamber".
  Entity hollow: place "Charcoal-burner's hollow".
  Entity gold: good "Coin". Entity rations: good "Ration". Entity clock: clock "Campaign watch".

  // Immutable historical discoveries, their evidence and initial distribution of knowledge.
  Discovery danger "The buried bell drove water upward when the old pumps stopped; Len fled after seeing it." {
    Known by len, iven.
    Denied by ada.
    Source report "Len's scratched warning beside the abandoned pump"
      at shaft readable by party destructible.
    Source bark "Len's account of the bell, scratched into charcoal bark"
      at hollow readable by party destructible.
  }

  Discovery charter "The town charter grants the miners the workings; Vey's purchased road deed excludes the mine." {
    Denied by vey.
    Source ledger "The road deed and miners' charter, displayed under the countinghouse seal"
      at guild readable by party.
  }

  Discovery tunnel "A ventilation crawl connects Heather ridge with the buried bell chamber, bypassing the pumping gallery." {
    Known by len.
    Source survey "Ventilation survey nailed to a fallen survey post"
      at ridge readable by party.
    Source escape_route "Len's ventilation sketch"
      at hollow readable by party spoken by len destructible.
  }

  Discovery absence "Len was last seen taking the ridge path rather than returning through the checkpoint." {
    Source notice "Mine roster: Len failed to return; Ada asks searchers to check the ridge"
      at square readable by party.
  }
  Initially Assert trusts(ada, party).
  Initially Assert trusts(vey, party).
  Initially Assert trusts(iven, party).
  Initially Assert trusts(len, party).

  // Geography: road -> square; western ridge bypasses the northern checkpoint.
  Initially Assert at(party, road). Initially Assert at(ada, mine). Initially Assert at(vey, toll).
  Initially Assert at(iven, shrine). Initially Assert at(len, hollow). Initially Assert at(echo, shaft).
  Initially Assert route(road, square). Initially Assert route(square, road).
  Initially Assert route(square, inn). Initially Assert route(inn, square).
  Initially Assert route(square, guild). Initially Assert route(guild, square).
  Initially Assert route(square, shrine). Initially Assert route(shrine, square).
  Initially Assert route(square, toll). Initially Assert route(toll, square).
  Initially Assert route(square, ridge). Initially Assert route(ridge, square).
  Initially Assert route(ridge, mine). Initially Assert route(mine, ridge).
  Initially Assert route(ridge, hollow). Initially Assert route(hollow, ridge).
  Initially Assert route(toll, mine). Initially Assert route(mine, toll).
  Initially Assert route(mine, shaft). Initially Assert route(shaft, mine).
  Initially Assert gate(echo, shaft, vault). Initially Assert route(vault, shaft).
  Initially Assert informedPassage(ridge, vault, tunnel).
  Initially Assert route(vault, ridge).

  Entity bell: mechanism "the bell's water-driven striker".
  Entity bulkhead: mechanism "the mine's emergency bulkhead".
  Initially Assert mounted(bell, vault). Initially Assert functioning(bell).
  Initially Assert mounted(bulkhead, mine). Initially Assert barrier(bulkhead, shaft).
  Initially Assert operates(party, bell). Initially Assert operates(party, bulkhead).
  Initially Assert operates(ada, bulkhead).
  Initially Assert seeksBacking(vey).
  Initially Assert mandate(vey, toll). Initially Assert mandate(vey, mine).
  Relation tainted(place). Relation displaced(group). Relation sheltered(group).
  Relation abandoned(place).
  Initially Assert unladen(party).

  // Competing commitments, evaluated by the existing bounded planner.
  Pursuit protect_workers for ada priority 30 when knows(ada, danger) and functioning(bell) seeks closed(shaft).
  Pursuit find_shelter for ada priority 20 when displaced(ada) and closed(shaft) and functioning(bell) seeks at(ada, inn).
  Pursuit reopen_safe_workings for ada priority 35 when not functioning(bell) seeks not closed(shaft).
  Pursuit resume_work for ada priority 10 when not functioning(bell) and not closed(shaft) seeks at(ada, mine).
  Pursuit secure_road for vey priority 10 when able(vey) and watch(clock) >= enforceAt(vey) seeks controlled(toll, vey).
  Pursuit secure_revenue for vey priority 9 when able(vey) and controlled(toll, vey) and not knows(vey, charter) seeks controlled(mine, vey).
  Pursuit return_to_checkpoint for vey priority 15 when knows(vey, charter) seeks at(vey, toll).
  Pursuit shelter_survivors for iven priority 20 when displaced(iven) seeks at(iven, inn).
  Pursuit return_home for len priority 10 when knows(len, charter) seeks at(len, inn).

  // Explicit causality. Rules run once in source order after each watch's NPC opportunities.
  Rule early_claim when supports(party, vey) and not controlled(toll, vey) {
    Set enforceAt(vey) to 1.
  }
  Rule contested_mandate when knows(vey, charter) and mandate(vey, mine) {
    Retract mandate(vey, mine).
    Retract controlled(mine, vey).
  }
  Rule occupation_ends when not able(vey) and (controlled(toll, vey) or controlled(mine, vey)) {
    Retract controlled(toll, vey). Retract controlled(mine, vey).
  }
  Rule road_exclusion when controlled(toll, vey) and not knows(vey, charter) and not supports(party, vey) {
    Assert denied(party, toll, mine).
  }
  Rule charter_access when knows(vey, charter) or supports(party, vey) or dead(vey) {
    Retract denied(party, toll, mine).
  }
  Rule revenue when controlled(mine, vey) and not closed(shaft) and quantity(ada, gold) >= 1 {
    Decrease quantity(ada, gold) by 1. Increase quantity(vey, gold) by 1.
  }
  Rule seepage when watch(clock) >= 30 and functioning(bell) and not closed(shaft) and not tainted(shrine) {
    Assert tainted(shrine).
  }
  Rule lost_livelihood when closed(shaft) and not displaced(ada) {
    Assert displaced(ada).
  }
  Rule flight when watch(clock) >= 42 and tainted(shrine) and functioning(bell) and not closed(shaft) and not displaced(iven) {
    Assert displaced(iven). Assert abandoned(square).
  }
  Rule new_shelter when displaced(ada) and at(ada, inn) and not sheltered(ada) {
    Assert sheltered(ada).
  }

  // Local observations: claims and evidence remain distinct from objective truth and actor knowledge.
  Observe arrival at road when true "Ore carts have stopped on the south road. Ahead, Blackvein's weighbridge rises between a tavern roof and the mine's black ridge. A chalk sign points north: 'MINE SHIFTS DELAYED — ask at the square.'".
  Observe town at square when not abandoned(square) "Miners wait by idle carts. The inn is west, the countinghouse east, the well shrine south. The north road leads to Vey's checkpoint; a western foot trail climbs Heather ridge. A roster asks after a missing miner. Two concerns dominate the square: who will own the mine, and why its pumps ring like bells.".
  Observe deserted at square when abandoned(square) "The weighbridge is deserted. Buckets hang unused above a foul well. The ridge road remains open; shelter can still be found at the Bent Pick.".
  Observe shelter at inn when not sheltered(ada) or not closed(shaft) "The Bent Pick smells of peat smoke. Spare blankets lie on a bench. Its keeper offers the loft to anyone driven from the workings; the offer is real even if the mine never reopens.".
  Observe displaced at inn when sheltered(ada) and closed(shaft) and at(ada, inn) and able(ada) "Ada and the displaced miners have taken the loft. Closing the workings kept the water below ground, but wages have stopped. Ada is available here to hear new evidence; the bell can still be reached from the ridge if you find the old survey.".
  Observe quiet_inn at inn when not functioning(bell) "The underground vibration has stopped even beneath the inn floor. Ada can return to check the bulkhead and reopen the workings. Any earlier displacement or spoiled water remains part of the town's history.".
  Observe deed at guild when true "The merchants want escorts on the road, but fear Vey will take the ore as well as the toll. They have displayed the original deeds so anyone can compare them. Caldus accepts a documented challenge to his mine claim; showing him the charter will not cancel his road rights.".
  Observe clean_well at shrine when not tainted(shrine) "A silver testing cup rests on the well. Iven's chalk warning reads: 'At the thirtieth watch the old pump reservoir will crest. Find what Len saw, or ask Ada to close the bulkhead. Closure costs wages. Silence the striker below and the mine can remain open.' He has marked the rising levels on the well stone.".
  Observe foul_well at shrine when tainted(shrine) "An oily black film covers the well. The water already drawn is spoiled even if the bell is silenced now. Iven's evacuation threshold is watch 42. Cutting off the source can still prevent further flight.".
  Observe checkpoint at toll when not controlled(toll, vey) and able(vey) and not supports(party, vey) "Caldus drills a road patrol. 'I secure the checkpoint at watch {enforceAt(vey)}, then the mine. Back me openly and I move sooner. The miners cannot keep this road safe alone.' His men have not yet taken control. You may leave by either road; the ridge bypass is unguarded.".
  Observe backing at toll when not controlled(toll, vey) and able(vey) and supports(party, vey) "Caldus enters your name beside his claim. He orders the checkpoint secured at his next opportunity. Backing him has made his timetable immediate.".
  Observe garrison at toll when controlled(toll, vey) "Vey's road banner flies above the checkpoint. The patrol has established an enduring claim on this road. The mine road is barred to you unless you back Caldus or establish the charter boundary. The ridge remains a physical alternative. A road victory does not settle the separate mine title.".
  Observe challenged at toll when knows(vey, charter) and able(vey) "Caldus has accepted the charter's boundary. He still wants road security, but has withdrawn his claim to mining revenue. The distinction matters: the checkpoint stays, the mine is no longer his objective.".
  Observe corpse at toll when dead(vey) "Caldus lies dead. His authority cannot act in his absence. His bloodied writ lies beside him. The patrol has no further orders.".
  Observe ridge at ridge when true "Heather hides an old survey post. East lies the minehead; a charcoal track descends west into a sheltered hollow. A cold draft rises through stones that do not match the hillside.".
  Observe work at mine when not closed(shaft) and not controlled(mine, vey) "The shift bell hangs silent beside the ore scales. A notice in Ada's hand reads: 'These are our workings. I won't throw away a winter's wages on a rumor. Bring evidence from Len or the old pump and I'll shut the bulkhead myself.' The pumping gallery descends below; the ridge offers another way back to town.".
  Observe levy at mine when controlled(mine, vey) and not closed(shaft) "Caldus has posted his seal on the ore scales. Mine revenue is now under his control: one coin of the miners' remaining pay is taken each watch until their purse runs dry. Ada still has the emergency key: title does not prevent her closing unsafe workings.".
  Observe closed_mine at mine when closed(shaft) "The emergency bulkhead is closed. No new shift can enter the pumping gallery. People already below can still climb out. The miners have lost their workplace. The Bent Pick has offered its loft as shelter. The sealed danger remains underground. The ventilation crawl can bypass the closure; silence the striker and reopening becomes a real option.".
  Observe pump at shaft when true "Water shivers upward in the old pump barrels. Len scratched a warning into the casing. Beyond it a listening echo blocks the bell door. You can fight it or retreat; a survey might reveal a route that avoids it altogether.".
  Observe bell_running at vault when functioning(bell) "An ancient bell hangs over a waterwheel. Each strike lifts a thread of black water toward the town. Its striker can be dismantled by hand. A cotter pin holds the striker arm. Remove it and the wheel will turn without sounding the bell.".
  Observe bell_silent at vault when not functioning(bell) "The striker is dismantled. Water drains downward again. The bell is silent; any well water already spoiled remains spoiled. The mine can remain productive if its entrance was not sealed.".
  Observe missing at hollow when at(len, hollow) and able(len) "Len is alive beneath the charcoal shelter. He left his account on bark, unwilling to approach the checkpoint. He has sketched the old ventilation crawl and can explain it from memory. 'Caldus will call me a trespasser in my own workings. Show me the charter and I will go home with a claim I can defend.' Learning it yourself does not tell Len anything; you must show him what you found.".
  Observe len_dead at hollow when at(len, hollow) and dead(len) "Len lies dead beneath the shelter. His charcoal-bark account remains beside the cold fire. His death has not erased what he wrote.".
  Observe empty_hollow at hollow when not at(len, hollow) "Len's cold fire remains beneath the charcoal shelter. His written account is still here. He has gone toward the inn; leaving did not erase what he witnessed.".
  Goal not functioning(bell).
}

Module margin "The northern margin" {
  Description "The northern camp supports trappers and salvagers beside a damaged winter shrine. The guide wants the path kept open; an altered wolf guards the old causeway.   Entity party: group "Your company". Entity village: place "Saint Orra's green".
  Entity gold: good "Coin". Entity rations: good "Ration". Entity clock: clock "Campaign watch".

  Person tala "Tala" at camp { Role "northern guide and trader". Class ranger. Level 2. Uses travel. }
  Person frostback "Frostback" at ford { Role "altered wolf". Race frost_wolf. Class rime_beast. }
  Entity font: mechanism "the winter shrine's ice-pump". Entity purse: stock "a salvager's scattered purse".
  Entity winter: pressure "The camp’s frost line".
  Relation frozen(place).
  Initially Assert route(village, track). Initially Assert route(track, village).
  Initially Assert route(track, camp). Initially Assert route(camp, track).
  Initially Assert route(camp, ford). Initially Assert route(ford, camp).
  Initially Assert gate(frostback, ford, shrine). Initially Assert route(shrine, ford).
  Initially Assert informedPassage(track, shrine, old_trail). Initially Assert route(shrine, track).
  Initially Assert restful(camp). Initially Assert offers(tala, rations).
  Initially Assert mounted(font, shrine). Initially Assert functioning(font). Initially Assert operates(party, font).
  Initially Assert at(purse, shrine). Initially Assert salvage(purse). Initially Set quantity(purse, gold) to 8.
  Initially Assert trusts(tala, party).
  Discovery old_trail "A dry shepherds' ledge runs from the northern track into the winter shrine, bypassing the ford." {
    Known by tala.
    Source trail_note "The guide's marked shepherds' route" at camp readable by party spoken by tala.
  }
  Discovery winter_engine "The winter shrine's ice-pump causes the spreading frost; dismantling its exposed intake stops further growth but does not repair frozen shelters." {
    Known by tala.
    Source tide_marks "A salvager's account of the ice-pump and its tide marks" at shrine readable by party.
  }
  Topic tala_welcome with tala "Ask the guide what keeps this camp alive" when true {
    Says "'Trappers, salvagers, and people who cannot afford a town bed,' the guide says. 'I have {quantity(tala, rations)} rations, two coins each while my stock lasts. Pallets here are safe for recovery while the shelters stand. The wolf at the ford is changed by old cold. Fire hurts it; cold barely does. You do not have to fight. Ask me for the shepherds' route. I leave for Orra at watch {departAt(winter)} if the frost has not stopped.'".
  }
  Topic tala_route with tala "Ask for a route around the altered wolf" when knows(tala, old_trail) {
    Says "The guide marks a dry ledge from the northern track to the shrine. 'You can enter without going near the ford. There is salvage beyond, but taking the money will not stop the ice-pump. You will have to choose whether to dismantle it.'".
    On discuss { Assert knows(actor, old_trail). Retract assumesFalse(actor, old_trail). }
  }
  Pursuit leave_danger for tala priority 20 when functioning(font) and watch(clock) >= departAt(winter) seeks at(tala, village).
  Pursuit reopen_trade for tala priority 10 when not functioning(font) and not frozen(camp) seeks at(tala, camp).
  Measure departAt(pressure). Measure freezeAt(pressure).
  Rule encroachment when watch(clock) >= freezeAt(winter) and functioning(font) and not frozen(camp) {
    Assert frozen(camp). Assert closed(camp). Retract restful(camp).
  }
  Observe approach at track when true "The northern track leaves Orra behind. A side path reaches a camp of trappers and salvagers. Beyond it the white ford leads to a ruined shrine. The guide at camp knows a way around the ford. You can return to Orra from here without entering the shrine.".
  Observe shelter at camp when not frozen(camp) "Pallets surround a small cookpot. The guide sells finite rations when present; recovery here takes six hours and one shared ration. A marked route lies beside the fire. The shelters will fail at watch {freezeAt(winter)} if the ice-pump still runs. The guide plans to leave at watch {departAt(winter)}.".
  Observe departure at camp when not at(tala, camp) and not frozen(camp) "The guide has left. You can still use the pallets, but there is no one here to trade. Quieting the shrine before the shelters freeze can bring the guide back.".
  Observe ice at camp when frozen(camp) "The shelters have split beneath ice. They no longer offer safe recovery. The old camp will remain damaged even if you stop the source. Orra's refuge is still reachable by the northern track.".
  Observe beast at ford when able(frostback) "The rime-matted wolf holds the causeway. Its cold bite can weaken a companion; its howl can stun unless resisted by wisdom. It resists physical and cold damage, but fire deals extra damage. A fire invocation from Ys can help. A guide's ledge can bypass the encounter entirely. Retreat preserves both sides' injuries.".
  Observe carcass at ford when dead(frostback) "The altered wolf lies dead. The causeway is clear. Its death has not dismantled the machine beyond it.".
  Observe working at shrine when functioning(font) "A bronze intake pumps silver-white cold into the ground. Its retaining pins are exposed and can be dismantled. A scattered purse lies among salvager's bones; you can take the money without repairing the shrine. The exit leads back toward the ford, and a dry ledge returns directly to the northern track.".
  Observe quiet at shrine when not functioning(font) "The intake has stopped. Frost no longer advances from the shrine. Any shelter already split by ice remains ruined. The purse and the dead remain where this history left them. You can return to Orra, recover and choose another journey.".
  Observe return_report at village when frozen(camp) and at(tala, village) and able(tala) "The northern guide has returned with a report: the camp's shelters split under the shrine's frost. Their supply service has moved with them; the old safe stopping place has been lost.".
  Observe signpost at village when true "A northern sign points toward a trappers' camp and a winter shrine. The guide there sells rations and knows the route. Ys went beneath the watchtower to the south of that margin; you can seek her, travel north or remain at the refuge. These are choices, not orders.".
  Goal false.
}

data/orra/refuge.kyr:
Module refuge "Ashes at Saint Orra" {
  Description "Saint Orra shelters quarry families beside a ruined watchtower. A child fell ill after drinking from the spring; the charcoal worker Tamsin is blamed. Keeper Mere has locked the guest house pending expulsion at watch 28. The kiln still warms the refuge. Investigate before lending your name to a judgment. Every action costs a watch; examining the scene never obliges you to take a side.".
  Entity party: group "Your company". Entity mere: group "Mere, keeper of the refuge".
  Entity tamsin: group "Tamsin, charcoal worker".
  Entity green: place "Saint Orra's green". Entity porch: place "Refuge porch".
  Entity cell: place "Locked guest house". Entity kiln: place "Charcoal kiln".
  Entity gold: good "Coin". Entity rations: good "Ration". Entity clock: clock "Campaign watch".
  Entity fellowship: capability "the Free Fellowship". Entity woodcraft: capability "ranger woodcraft".
  Entity cistern: stock "Refuge water reserve". Entity water: good "Clean water".
  Entity latch: mechanism "guest-house latch". Entity furnace: mechanism "kiln's forced-draft bellows".
  Relation expelled(group). Relation spoiled(place).
  Initially Assert at(cistern, green). Initially Set quantity(cistern, water) to 2.
  Initially Assert mayCollect(party, cistern). Initially Assert unladen(party).
  Initially Assert at(party, green). Initially Assert at(mere, porch). Initially Assert at(tamsin, cell).
  Initially Assert route(green, porch). Initially Assert route(porch, green).
  Initially Assert route(green, kiln). Initially Assert route(kiln, green).
  Initially Assert route(porch, cell). Initially Assert route(cell, porch). Initially Assert closed(cell).
  Initially Assert mounted(latch, porch). Initially Assert barrier(latch, cell). Initially Assert operates(mere, latch).
  Initially Assert keyedBy(latch, mere).
  Initially Assert mounted(furnace, kiln). Initially Assert functioning(furnace).
  Initially Assert operates(party, furnace). Initially Assert operates(mere, furnace).
  Initially Assert recognizes(mere, fellowship).
  Initially Assert trusts(mere, party). Initially Assert trusts(tamsin, party).
  Discovery runoff "Silver residue from the watchtower stones is carried into the spring by the kiln's forced draft; Tamsin did not poison the water." {
    Denied by mere.
    Source cup "Ys’s signed water analysis beneath the testing cup" at green readable by party.
    Source ledger "Firing ledger: illness follows silver-stone firings, even during Tamsin's absence" at kiln readable by party destructible.
  }
  Discovery whereabouts "Healer Ys went beneath the watchtower to recover its silver drain-key. She is alive, not hiding stolen medicine." {
    Known by tamsin.
    Source letter "Ys's letter entrusted to Tamsin" at cell readable by party spoken by tamsin.
  }
  Discovery crawl "A charcoal flue behind the kiln enters the watchtower's undercroft, bypassing the guardian's stair." {
    Source sketch "Chalk flue survey behind the bellows" at kiln readable by party destructible.
  }
  Pursuit hear_challenge for mere priority 30 when knows(mere, runoff) seeks not closed(cell).
  Pursuit stop_poison for mere priority 20 when knows(mere, runoff) seeks not functioning(furnace).
  Pursuit return_to_duty for mere priority 10 when not functioning(furnace) and not closed(cell) seeks at(mere, porch).
  Pursuit seek_work for tamsin priority 10 when not closed(cell) seeks at(tamsin, kiln).
  Rule fellowship_hearing when released(mere) and closed(cell) { Retract closed(cell). }
  Rule expulsion when watch(clock) >= 28 and able(mere) and not knows(mere, runoff) and not expelled(tamsin) {
    Assert expelled(tamsin). Assert at(tamsin, green). Assert closed(cell).
  }
  Rule pollution when watch(clock) >= 20 and functioning(furnace) and not spoiled(green) { Assert spoiled(green). Set quantity(cistern, water) to 0. }
  Observe arrival at green when not spoiled(green) and not knows(mere, runoff) "A barefoot child watches the testing cup beside the spring. A chalk notice blames Tamsin for the sickness; the cup covers Ys's sealed water analysis. Her note and the firing ledger can be read independently. East is the refuge porch, west the kiln, north the moor and ruined watchtower. Mere hears documented challenges. Read the analysis or the kiln ledger before accepting the accusation. The spring will be spoiled at watch 20 if firing continues.".
  Observe polluted at green when spoiled(green) "A silver scum covers the spring. Stopping the bellows now prevents further discharge but cannot restore the stored water. The refuge's clean-water reserve has been emptied. Water collected earlier remains yours.".
  Observe judgment at porch when closed(cell) and able(mere) "Mere holds the guest-house key. 'One sick child and a missing healer. I cannot risk another. I will open a hearing if you bring evidence against my judgment.' Her founding compact also admits a company of human, elf and dwarf together. Tamsin's expulsion is set for watch 28. The door is a physical barrier; if its keeper falls, you can recover her key and open it yourself; that proves nothing about the charge.".
  Observe hearing at porch when not closed(cell) "The guest-house door stands open. Tamsin can leave; Mere's decision is no longer a prison sentence. The illness and the missing healer remain separate problems. Disabling the kiln ends the discharge but also its warmth.".
  Observe guest at cell when at(tamsin, cell) "Tamsin sits beside a letter. 'Ys went to the tower, not away with the medicine. I promised to wait for her. Burning old stone made the glaze white; I thought it harmless.' She offers the letter freely. She cannot tell you what happened after Ys descended.".
  Observe empty at cell when not at(tamsin, cell) "Tamsin's blanket is folded on the empty pallet. Her letter remains; a person's departure does not erase written evidence.".
  Observe fire at kiln when functioning(furnace) "Bellows drive hot air through silver-flecked stones scavenged from the watchtower. You can dismantle the draft here without anyone's permission. It will stop the firing—and the refuge's heat. A ledger and flue survey lie under a loose slate. The water discharge will reach the spring at watch 20.".
  Observe cold at kiln when not functioning(furnace) "The dismantled bellows lie beside cold stone. No more silver ash rises toward the spring. Families huddle under blankets: removing a danger did not replace their livelihood or heat. The tower's drain still needs attention.".
  Observe cleared at kiln when knows(mere, runoff) and at(tamsin, kiln) "Tamsin has returned to her workplace after Mere accepted the evidence. The false accusation is withdrawn; the cold kiln remains a real loss. 'Find Ys. She knew how to drain the tower without firing these stones.'".
  Observe banished at green when expelled(tamsin) and at(tamsin, green) "Tamsin waits outside with her blanket. The expulsion happened even while you were elsewhere. Evidence can still change Mere's knowledge; it cannot erase the day Tamsin lost her shelter.".
  Goal false.
}

Module tower "The Hart Below" {
  Description "Above Orra's spring stands a watchtower built over a drowned burial vault. Ys the healer sought its drain-key. A hungry wolf guards the approach; a speaking revenant guards the stair.   Entity party: group "Your company". Entity green: place "Saint Orra's green".
  Entity kiln: place "Charcoal kiln". Entity furnace: mechanism "kiln's forced-draft bellows".
  Entity crawl: fact "The charcoal flue".

  Entity ys: group "Ys, the missing healer".
  Entity gold: good "Coin". Entity rations: good "Ration". Entity clock: clock "Campaign watch".
  Entity fellowship: capability "the Free Fellowship". Entity woodcraft: capability "ranger woodcraft".
  Entity siphon: mechanism "the silver siphon". Entity hatch: mechanism "reservoir inspection hatch".
  Relation flooded(place). Relation rescued(group).
  Initially Assert at(wolf, moor). Initially Assert at(hart, cairn). Initially Assert at(ys, vault).
  Initially Assert route(green, moor). Initially Assert route(moor, green).
  Initially Assert gate(wolf, moor, cairn). Initially Assert route(cairn, moor).
  Initially Assert gate(hart, cairn, vault). Initially Assert route(vault, cairn).
  Initially Assert informedPassage(kiln, vault, crawl). Initially Assert route(vault, kiln).
  Initially Assert route(vault, spring). Initially Assert route(spring, vault).
  Initially Assert mounted(siphon, spring). Initially Assert functioning(siphon). Initially Assert operates(party, siphon).
  Initially Assert mounted(hatch, vault). Initially Assert barrier(hatch, spring). Initially Assert closed(spring).
  Initially Assert operates(party, hatch). Initially Assert operates(ys, hatch).
  Initially Assert gatekeeper(wolf). Initially Assert acceptsFood(wolf). Initially Assert receptive(wolf, woodcraft).
  Initially Set claim(wolf) to 9999. Initially Set mercy(wolf) to 9999.
  Initially Assert trusts(hart, party). Initially Assert trusts(ys, party).
  Discovery burial "The antlered warden swore to keep grave robbers from the reservoir. Ys entered to drain it, not plunder the dead." {
    Known by ys.
    Denied by hart.
    Source inscription "An oath carved into the watchtower stair" at cairn readable by party.
    Source account "Ys's account of her descent" at vault readable by party spoken by ys.
  }
  Pursuit hungry for wolf priority 10 when not sated(wolf) seeks sated(wolf).
  Pursuit let_pass for wolf priority 9 when sated(wolf) seeks released(wolf).
  Pursuit honor_oath for hart priority 30 when knows(hart, burial) seeks at(hart, moor).
  Pursuit open_drain for ys priority 20 when able(ys) seeks not closed(spring).
  Pursuit homeward for ys priority 10 when not functioning(siphon) seeks at(ys, green).
  Rule oath_passage when knows(hart, burial) and not released(hart) { Assert released(hart). }
  Rule overflow when watch(clock) >= 36 and functioning(siphon) and not flooded(moor) { Assert flooded(moor). Assert closed(cairn). }
  Rule home when at(ys, green) and not rescued(ys) { Assert rescued(ys). }
  Observe trail at moor when not flooded(moor) and able(wolf) and not released(wolf) "A gaunt she-wolf stands over a den at the tower path. She watches your food, not your throat. A ranger can read her warning and pass; anyone can give her a ration and wait for her to eat. You may fight, but her death will be permanent. The green is behind you; the watchtower lies beyond her.".
  Observe quiet at moor when released(wolf) or dead(wolf) "The path to the watchtower is passable. Beyond the broken arch, antlers scrape against stone. A low voice repeats an oath. The reservoir's tide mark is climbing toward watch 36.".
  Observe flood at moor when flooded(moor) "Silver water has drowned the direct tower path. The collapse cannot be reversed by stopping the siphon now. The charcoal flue remains another entrance if you discovered it. The green is still reachable.".
  Observe warden at cairn when able(hart) and not released(hart) "A revenant wearing a stag's skull bars the stair. 'No plunderer passes.' The oath is carved beside its hand. Ordinary weapons deal half damage to it; fire deals half again as much, radiant twice as much. It can drain life, shield itself and cast sleep resisted by wisdom. Reading and communicating its oath may establish why you came; it is not a promise that every undead creature will listen.".
  Observe departed at cairn when released(hart) "The warden has accepted the healer's purpose and left the stair. Its oath remains carved in stone. The reservoir is still dangerous; gaining passage did not repair it.".
  Observe slain at cairn when dead(hart) "The antlered skull is broken. The stair is clear. No one remains here to guard the dead, and the tide continues to rise.".
  Observe healer at vault when at(ys, vault) and able(ys) "Ys crouches above a silver tide. 'I can open the inspection hatch. You can dismantle the siphon beyond it; I cannot abandon the patients above until this is done.' The charcoal flue leads back to the kiln. The guardian's stair leads up to the watchtower.".
  Observe working at spring when functioning(siphon) "Silver water climbs through a narrow glass tube. Its intake brace is exposed. Dismantling the siphon prevents the reservoir overflowing at watch 36; any flooded ground stays flooded. The hatch and undercroft remain behind you.".
  Observe drained at spring when not functioning(siphon) "The tube drains and the water falls below the tide marks. The reservoir has stopped climbing. Ys can return by the tower path. The stair allows anyone already below to leave; the guardian bars entry, not escape.".
  Observe returned at green when rescued(ys) and able(ys) "Ys has returned from below the watchtower. She has seen what poisoned the spring and can offer her account here. The missing-person search is over, but spoiled water, a lost kiln and dead creatures remain consequences of your history.".
  Goal false.
}

data/rulesets/devotion.kyr:
Module devotion "Shared traditions and source-bound shrine blessings" {
  Kind deity. Kind shrine.
  Relation shrineOf(shrine, deity).
  Relation honored(group, shrine).
  Relation persistentWard(ability).
  Entity orsino_fireproof: ability "Resist Fire".
  Initially Assert persistentWard(orsino_fireproof).
  Goal false.
  Action field_ward(actor: group, caster: member, technique: ability, recipient: member, site: place) "Have {caster} ward {recipient} with {technique}" {
    Description "Prepare a persistent protective ward before entering danger. Normal mana is paid; duration counts owner-combat-turn boundaries rather than travel time.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and memberOf(caster, actor) and memberOf(recipient, actor)
      and persistentWard(technique) and awake(caster) and awake(recipient)
      and canCast(caster, technique) and treatable(recipient, technique).
    Resolve invoke(technique, caster, recipient).
    Result "The companion prepares a protective ward. Its normal mana cost is paid, its source is recorded, and it persists into the next encounter.".
  }
  Action seek_blessing(actor: group, altar: shrine, patron: deity, recipient: member, site: place) "Keep the observance at {altar} for {recipient}" {
    Description "A companion versed in burial lore leads Veyra's observance. Spend one shared ration as hospitality. This shrine grants its blessing once per company: +2 to saves, for three owner-combat-turn boundaries. Travel does not consume it. It cannot stack with another shrine's identical blessing.".
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, site) and at(altar, site) and shrineOf(altar, patron)
      and capable(actor, burial_lore) and memberOf(recipient, actor) and awake(recipient)
      and quantity(actor, rations) >= 1 and not honored(actor, altar).
    Resolve bless(altar, patron, recipient).
    On success { Decrease quantity(actor, rations) by 1. Assert honored(actor, altar). }
    Result "You share food in the Keeper's name. A wayfarer's protection settles on the chosen companion; its source and remaining combat lifetime persist.".
  }
}

data/rulesets/world/passages.kyr:
Module world_passages "Passages, obstacles and the condition of things" {
  Kind passage. Kind condition. Kind change. Kind thing. Kind waykind. Kind hazard.
  Relation passageKind(passage, waykind). Measure travelTime(passage).
  Relation connects(passage, place, place).
  Relation on(entity, passage).
  Relation guards(group, passage).
  Relation state(entity, condition) exclusive.
  Relation blocksWhen(entity, condition). Relation harmsWhen(entity, condition).
  Relation hurtsWith(entity, hazard). Relation hurtsInto(entity, condition).
  Relation revealedBy(passage, fact).
  Relation needs(entity, entity).
  Relation changeOf(change, entity). Relation changeFrom(change, condition). Relation changeTo(change, condition).
  Relation changeKnows(change, fact). Relation consumes(change, good).
  Relation hobbled(group).
  Relation following(group, group).
  Query holding(a: group, k: itemkind) means memberOf(?m, a) and ownedItem(?i, ?m) and itemKind(?i, k).
  Query meets(a: group, n: entity) means capable(a, n) or holding(a, n) or (following(a, ?l) and holding(?l, n)).
  Query equippedFor(a: group, x: entity) means not needs(x, ?n) or (needs(x, ?n) and meets(a, ?n)).
  Query informedFor(a: group, c: change) means not changeKnows(c, ?f) or (changeKnows(c, ?f) and knows(a, ?f)).
  Query visibleTo(w: passage, a: group) means not revealedBy(w, ?f) or (revealedBy(w, ?f) and knows(a, ?f))
    or (revealedBy(w, ?g) and following(a, ?l) and knows(?l, ?g)).
  Query obstructed(w: passage) means (on(?o, w) and state(?o, ?s) and blocksWhen(?o, ?s))
    or (guards(?g, w) and able(?g) and state(?g, ?t) and blocksWhen(?g, ?t)).
  Query hazardous(w: passage) means on(?h, w) and state(?h, ?s) and harmsWhen(?h, ?s).
  Query mobile(a: group) means not hobbled(a) or following(a, ?l).
  Query together(a: group, b: group) means at(a, ?p) and at(b, ?p).
  Query reaches(a: group, t: entity) means (at(a, ?p) and at(t, ?p)) or (at(a, ?q) and on(t, ?w) and connects(?w, ?q, ?r)).
  Query passable(w: passage, a: group) means visibleTo(w, a) and not obstructed(w) and not hazardous(w)
    and equippedFor(a, w).
  Goal false.

  Action go(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place) "Take {way} to {destination}" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and passable(way, actor)
      and mobile(actor).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert at(actor, destination). }
    Seen "{actor} takes {way} toward {destination}.".
  }
  Action risk(actor: group, way: passage, origin: place, destination: place, trap: entity, blow: hazard, after: condition, victim: member) "Risk {trap}; {victim} goes first" {
    Requires able(actor) and at(actor, origin) and connects(way, origin, destination) and on(trap, way)
      and state(trap, ?s) and harmsWhen(trap, ?s) and hurtsWith(trap, blow) and hurtsInto(trap, after)
      and memberOf(victim, actor) and awake(victim) and visibleTo(way, actor) and not obstructed(way)
      and equippedFor(actor, way) and mobile(actor).
    Resolve expose(blow, victim).
    Time travelTime(way).
    On success { Assert state(trap, after). Assert at(actor, destination). }
    On failure { Assert state(trap, after). }
  }
  Action change_thing(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition) "{how}" {
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and not consumes(how, ?g).
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). }
  }
  Action change_thing_paying(actor: group, how: change, thing: entity, origin: condition, result: condition, spent: good) "{how}" {
    Requires able(actor) and changeOf(how, thing) and changeFrom(how, origin) and changeTo(how, result)
      and state(thing, origin) and reaches(actor, thing) and equippedFor(actor, how) and informedFor(actor, how)
      and consumes(how, spent) and quantity(actor, spent) >= 1.
    On success { Assert state(thing, result). Decrease quantity(actor, spent) by 1. }
  }
}

Module sanctuary "The Open Hand Sanctuary" {
  Description "Cira's refusal to shelter travelers outside her order has brought a dispute to the sanctuary porch. She has promised to honor the founders' own charter if shown that she has misread its obligations.".
  Entity party: group "A traveler". Entity cira: group "Cira, sanctuary keeper".
  Entity porch: place "Pilgrims' porch". Entity hall: place "Sanctuary hall".
  Entity gold: good "Coin". Entity rations: good "Ration". Entity clock: clock "Campaign watch".
  Entity bolt: mechanism "the sanctuary bolt".
  Initially Assert at(party, porch). Initially Assert at(cira, porch).
  Initially Assert trusts(cira, party).
  Initially Assert route(porch, hall). Initially Assert route(hall, porch).
  Initially Assert closed(hall).
  Initially Assert mounted(bolt, porch). Initially Assert barrier(bolt, hall).
  Initially Assert operates(cira, bolt).
  Discovery founding_oath "The founders dedicated the sanctuary hall to travelers of every faith." {
    Denied by cira.
    Source charter "The founders' charter" at porch readable by party.
  }
  // Her commitment is specific: accept this historical charter and open the physical barrier.
  Pursuit honor_founders for cira priority 20 when knows(cira, founding_oath) seeks not closed(hall).
  Observe locked at porch when closed(hall) "Cira keeps the bolt drawn. 'I keep the founders' vow. Their charter is on the porch; if it binds me to shelter travelers of every faith, show me.' You can read it here, but reading does not tell Cira what you found.".
  Observe opened at porch when not closed(hall) "Cira has drawn the bolt after accepting the founders' charter. The inner hall stands open; you can enter or leave.".
  Observe shelter at hall when true "Worn pallets line the quiet stone hall. The porch remains open behind you.".
  Goal not closed(hall).
}

I sell finite medicines and rations. The dry stores hold a line; take it before trying the hoist or deep clefts. Antidote treats poison, not a crushed skull. Your purchases belong to the companion you name.'".
  }
  Topic nera_interest with nera "Ask why the town cares about Censer Hill" when true { Says "'Bronze buys work; washed-out bones buy grief. Edda needs the tram bearing. Iven needs names kept with their dead. Pell has not come home. You can choose one of those reasons, or none. Bring back a useful tool and the next expedition may reach somewhere the first could not.'".
  }
  Topic iven_mandate with iven "Ask Iven about the Custodian and burial custody" when true { Says "'I do not command a monster by feeling righteous,' Iven says. 'Its mandate is written. Bring word that the name register survives. A company trained in burial lore, or recognized under the Free Fellowship compact, can carry my custody writ. The guardian honors a named record and that writ. Killing it will open the way too, but leaves no keeper below.'".
  }

  Observe scene_quay at quay when true "Barges nose into reed-fringed piles. Wool bales and repaired hulls keep Reedwake working. Censer Hill rises beyond the willow causeway: a derelict foundry above old flood-refuge chambers. West are Nera's supplies and the inn; east, the common shrine and salvage office. Washed-out burial bones trouble the boatmen. No one agrees that everything beneath the hill is salvage.".
  Observe scene_inn at inn when true "Dry boots hang above the hearth. A shared ration buys six hours on the upstairs pallets, with full recovery for living companions and treatment of bleeding. Poison requires an antidote or purification. The dead remain dead. A chalk board lists the road to Censer Hill and a note: 'Bring a line. Leave enough strength to come back.'".
  Observe scene_shrine at shrine when true "Two small altars face one another: the Keeper of Names, whose dead must not be lost, and the Returning Current, patron of safe journeys and reciprocal aid. Iven sorts water-stained name slips. His institution, not an anonymous force of magic, claims custody of Censer Hill's named burials.".
  Observe scene_outfitter at outfitter when true "Oilcloth, line, salves and carefully counted rations fill the shelves. Nera equips repeat customers; she cannot restock a limitless expedition. Physical medicines here are unique bottles. Choose their recipient when buying, then use or equip them from the party inventory. The climbing line in the hill's dry stores may open routes that strength alone cannot.".
  Observe scene_salvage at salvage when true "The licensed company's ledger is open to a sketch of a bronze tram bearing. Edda has gone to the upper workshop; a permit deadline may bring her back empty-handed. The office is not the burial society. A metal claim does not convey ownership of human remains.".
  Observe scene_causeway at causeway when true "Willow roots bind the old stone causeway across the reed floodplain. Waterfowl lift from the sedges. The dry ridge climbs to the foundry yard; a low path leads to the exposed drain. A rooted boar bars the drain path, but a woodcraft company can read its warning posture and pass without violence. A bed of edible marsh cress grows beside the willow poles; woodcraft can gather finite rations. The river mark rises later today; the ridge remains dry.".
  Observe scene_ridge at ridge when true "Short grass and hawthorn cling to pale limestone. Sheep bells sound from distant Chalkcross. A hazel stand offers finite edible nuts to a woodcraft company. The foundry yard lies uphill, Reedwake below. A worn hillside track descends toward the drain: a second way into the hill, not a portal to its end.".
  Observe scene_yard at yard when true "Rusting tram rails cross an ash-grown yard. The roofless vestibule enters level I; the causeway and ridge return to town. A surveyor's scratches mark a possible climb between this yard and the hoist shaft. Without a proper line the shaft is too exposed. The foundry once served all three river settlements; no faction built it alone.".
  Observe scene_drain at drain when true "A broken culvert breathes cold air beside the reeds. At low water it reaches level II's sluice walk. A chalk passage also returns here once its route is learned underground. The tide board's red notch means the culvert is under water; this blocks the entrance, not every way out.".
  Observe scene_vestibule at vestibule when trapped(pell) "A broken rack pins Pell's coat and boot beneath a timber. He is alive, angry and reachable. You can shift the rack and escort him back through ordinary routes. The workshop lies beyond. A survey board names the dry stores and an upper hoist; helping Pell need not mean carrying out Edda's salvage contract.".
  Observe scene_workshop at workshop when true "Half-cast bells lean against the wall. Edda's chalk circles identify reusable bronze, while burial marks below the stair declare another institution's custody. Routes reach the vestibule, casting gallery and dry stores. You can find wealth here without descending to the dead.".
  Observe scene_gallery at gallery when able(roost) "Ceramic moulds make narrow islands beneath a collapsed roof. A cave hound scavenges at the hoist entrance. You can fight, use ranger woodcraft to leave it unprovoked, or return through the stores to the dry refuge stair. Its survival does not reset when you leave.".
  Observe scene_furnace at furnace when true "A cracked furnace opens beneath the gallery. Slag-glass catches the light; a narrow workers’ loop joins the workshop and gallery. The safe floor here allows you to pause, count supplies and decide between the dry stores and the exposed hoist. The cold hearth holds only weathered slag; the great bell mould has split.".
  Observe scene_hoist at hoist when true "A slack cable loops around the hoist drum. The uncovered counterweight hangs above a narrow descent to the upper landing. A scored timber records how it releases. Read it before committing a leading companion. A line can brace the mechanism; a delving specialist can disarm it. The climbing scar rises to the yard.".
  Observe scene_stores at stores when true "A collapsed oilcloth chest stands against the inner wall. The dry stair descends to the refuge without touching the hoist counterweight. Taking the line gives a real tool to a particular companion; it is not a flag that ends the adventure.".
  Observe scene_stair at stair when true "Soot-black stone steps descend from the stores. Refuge arrows point toward the flood hall; return arrows point up. Even when the drain floods, this stair remains a dependable exit.".
  Observe scene_landing at landing when true "The hoist cage has sunk into gravel. A narrow crawl joins the flood hall; above is the spent or still-dangerous counterweight crossing. Returning by the dry stair avoids trusting the mechanism twice.".
  Observe scene_hall at hall when true "Three settlements carved their household tallies on the refuge pillars. The flood hall connects the dry stair, hoist landing, old kitchens and sluice walk. This was a shelter before it became an ossuary. The voices of the dead are not a substitute for the surviving register.".
  Observe scene_kitchen at kitchen when true "A sealed preservative crock has split beneath the route to the name room. Greenish dust traces the floor. The warning label identifies the vapour and the release; you can prepare an antidote, disarm it with delving, brace its lid with a line, risk exposure, or reach the lower vaults another way.".
  Observe scene_name_room at name_room when true "Waxed shelves and a funeral lampstand occupy the dry wall. The register identifies the families in the crypt; it is evidence of people, not proof that all valuables are yours. Tiny shining lettering on the rear wall suggests a concealed stair. An equipped names lantern makes that lettering legible.".
  Observe scene_sluice at sluice when true "Stone gutters run from the exposed drain through the old refuge. A dry wall-walk reaches the lower landing even when the entrance culvert floods. Flood marks record the next rise; the refuge stair remains an alternative way home.".
  Observe scene_lower at lower when true "A stair of river-smoothed limestone leaves the sluice walk and turns toward the family crypt. The path back is visible. Cold incense lies in the air. Old footmarks turn toward the family crypt.".
  Observe scene_crypt at crypt when true "Small alcoves hold bundled remains under numbered tiles. The hidden stair from the name room emerges behind a screen here. The Custodian's court stands ahead. A cleft leads to the founders' gallery, but descending it safely requires a line: lawful passage and physical bypass are different advantages.".
  Observe scene_court at court when true "A bronze dais rises beneath articulated burial shutters. It is funerary bronze and stone, bound to recognize a custody writ supported by the surviving names. It does not read your conscience. Present lawful records, fight it, or turn back. The shutter route offers another dangerous path toward the founders' gallery; its scratched warning is readable before crossing.".
  Observe scene_vault at vault when true "Named stone drawers remain in order. An offering tray stands before the named drawers. The guardian's permission admits you; it has not sold the dead. The court remains behind you. If you killed the guardian, its heavy footsteps have fallen silent.".
  Observe scene_founders at founders when true "Three bronze founders hold tools rather than crowns. Their plinths name the flood-refuge compact of Reedwake, Chalkcross and Brackenholt. A chalk passage leads toward the surface. A line can also climb to the family crypt. A small purse and a funerary technique remain; choosing a reward does not end the campaign.".
  Observe scene_chalk at chalk when true "A pale fault runs upward to the exposed drain. Survey scratches on this side reveal the way through, permanently adding it to your usable geography. Once known, it becomes another route for retreat or a second expedition. Your old footprints remain undisturbed beneath the dust.".
  Observe river_risen at drain when highWater(flood) "The red notch is under water. The culvert entrance is closed to you; an occupied sluice walk can still leave. The ridge, dry stair and learned chalk route remain available.".
  Observe edda_home at salvage when at(edda, quay) "Edda has withdrawn from the hill. Her permit deadline elapsed whether you were there or not. The bearing remains where this history left it.".
  Observe pell_safe at quay when at(pell, quay) and rescued(pell) "Pell is back at the river, alive because someone actually escorted him out. His old place in the vestibule is empty.".
  Observe guardian_dead at court when dead(custodian) "The Custodian lies still. Its burial chain hangs severed from a bronze hand. This is a lasting opening, and a lasting loss of the burial society’s protection.".
  Observe custody at court when custodyGranted(custodian, party) "The Custodian steps aside under the written mandate. Its force and the named burials remain intact.".
  Observe unpinned at vestibule when rescued(pell) and at(pell, vestibule) "The lifted rack rests against the wall. Pell is free and waiting. The workshop lies ahead; the yard leads home. Escort moves the company and Pell together along an ordinary route.".
  Observe empty_vestibule at vestibule when not at(pell, vestibule) "The lifted timber rack has been left against the wall. Pell has departed. His old survey scratches still point toward the workshop and dry stores.".
  Observe quiet_gallery at gallery when dead(roost) "The cave hound lies still beneath the moulds. The passage to the hoist remains clear. Its death has not repaired the exposed counterweight below.".
  Observe guardian_present at court when able(custodian) "The Mortuary Custodian waits on the dais, articulated bronze and stone. Its mandating inscription is visible. Address it, present the specified authority, withdraw or risk a confrontation.".
  Observe line_present at stores when at(line_cache, stores) "Inside the oilcloth chest lies a surveyor’s line and pitons. Choose a companion to carry it, then equip it for climbing and bracing.".
  Observe bearing_present at hoist when at(bearing_cache, hoist) "A heavy bronze bearing lies beside the drum, stamped with the salvage company’s chalk. Edda’s commission pays six coins for this actual object.".
  Observe register_present at name_room when at(register_cache, name_room) "The waxed refuge register lies on a stone reading stand. Its pages identify the families whose remains lie below.".
  Observe lantern_present at name_room when at(lantern_cache, name_room) "A warded names lantern stands in the lampstand. It needs no oil in this bounded funerary enchantment; equipping it reveals the concealed funerary inscriptions.".
  Observe charm_present at vault when at(charm_cache, vault) "A preserved relic rests in the offering tray. Inspect its actual equipment description before choosing a bearer; its fitted attachment changes that companion’s effective capabilities while equipped.".
  Rule inscription_dark when not capable(party, spectralSight) { Retract noticeable(lantern_letters). }
  Goal false.
}
data/sites/reedwake/site.kyr:
Module reedwake "Reedwake and Censer Hill" {
  Description "A river town on the Serewater, a willow floodplain, and the derelict bellfoundry on the hill beyond it.".

  Place march "The Serewater March" is region.
  Place reedwake_town "Reedwake" is settlement within march at 0, 0.
  Place reedlands "Willow floodplain" is wilderness within march at 1, 0.
  Place censer_hill "Censer Hill foundry" is site within march at 2, 0.
  Place oar "The Returning Oar" is building within reedwake_town.
  Place shop "Nera's shop" is building within reedwake_town.
  Place shrine_house "The common shrine" is building within reedwake_town.
  Place ferry_house "Ferry house" is building within reedwake_town.
  Place works "The upper works" is level within censer_hill.

  Place quay "Reedwake quay" is room within reedwake_town at 1, 1.
  Place taproom "the Oar's taproom" is room within oar at 1, 0.
  Place shop_floor "Nera's shop floor" is room within shop at 2, 1.
  Place shrine "the shrine" is room within shrine_house at 1, 2.
  Place ferry_room "the ferry house" is room within ferry_house at 0, 1.
  Place causeway "Willow causeway" is room within reedlands at 0, 1.
  Place ridge "Chalk ridge" is room within reedlands at 1, 0.
  Place yard "Foundry yard" is room within censer_hill at 0, 0.
  Place drain_mouth "Drain mouth" is room within censer_hill at 0, 2.
  Place vestibule "Surveyor's vestibule" is room within works at 1, 0.
  Place workshop "Bell workshop" is room within works at 1, 1.
  Place stores "Dry stores" is room within works at 2, 0.
  Place boiler "The valve chamber" is room within works at 2, 1.
  Place gallery "Casting gallery" is room within works at 1, 2.
  Place hoist "Hoist room" is room within works at 2, 2.

  Passage oar_door "the Oar's door" is door between taproom and quay.
  Passage shop_door "Nera's shop door" is door between shop_floor and quay.
  Passage shrine_door "the shrine porch" is doorway between shrine and quay.
  Passage ferry_door "the ferry-house door" is door between ferry_room and quay.
  Passage causeway_path "the causeway path" is path between quay and causeway taking 1 hour.
  Passage ridge_track "the ridge track" is track between causeway and ridge taking 30 minutes.
  Passage yard_track "the track up to the yard" is track between ridge and yard taking 30 minutes.
  Passage low_path "the low path through the reeds" is path between causeway and drain_mouth taking 30 minutes.
  Passage arch "the roofless arch" is arch between yard and vestibule.
  Passage culvert "the drain culvert" is culvert between drain_mouth and workshop.
  Passage workshop_door "the workshop doorway" is doorway between vestibule and workshop.
  Passage stores_door "the stores door" is door between workshop and stores.
  Passage gallery_steps "the gallery steps" is steps between workshop and gallery.
  Passage boiler_arch "the boiler arch" is arch between workshop and boiler.
  Passage pipe_walk "the pipe walk" between boiler and gallery.
  Passage hoist_passage "the hoist passage" between gallery and hoist.
  Passage tram_crawl "the old tram crawl" is crawl between stores and hoist hidden until crawl_known.

  Company party "Your company" of 3 at quay.
  Initially Set quantity(party, gold) to 6. Initially Set quantity(party, rations) to 1.

  Person maud "Maud" at taproom {
    Role "innkeeper". Profession innkeeper. Peaceable.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 4.
  }
  Person nera "Nera" at shop_floor {
    Role "herbalist". Profession herbalist. Peaceable.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 6.
    Sells bandages for 1 coin from 3.
    Sells rope for 1 coin from 2.
    Sells healingdraught for 3 coin from 1.
  }
  Person iven "Iven" at shrine {
    Role "priest of the Keeper of Names". Profession priest. Peaceable.
  }
  Person hound "Ash" at gallery {
    Role "a cave hound". Species cave_hound. Level 2.
    State guarding blocking "A lean cave hound stands across the hoist passage, head low, lips back from its teeth.".
    State calm "The cave hound lies in the mould dust, watching, no longer barring the hoist passage.".
    Guards hoist_passage.
    Change soothe "Approach {self} slowly, low and quiet" from guarding to calm needing woodcraft.
    Change feed "Toss {self} a ration" from guarding to calm consuming rations.
  }
  Event growl near hound when state(hound, guarding) and together(party, hound) "The hound's growl fills the gallery. It does not come at you; it holds the hoist passage.".
  Initially Set encounterXp(hound) to 20.
  Person hesta "Hesta" at gallery {
    Role "the foundry's herb gatherer". Profession herbalist. Peaceable.
    Offers healing "clean water, salve and linen" for 2 coin.
    Sells rations for 2 coin from 2.
  }
  Topic hesta_help with hesta "Ask Hesta about Ash and the missing surveyor" when not refusesService(hesta, actor) {
    Says "'Ash kept me company after the foundry closed. Give him space, a little food, or that quiet hunter's look. I'll dress your wounds if you need it. But don't strike him in front of me and then ask me to patch you up. The ward blade is still in the valve chamber; fire runs along it, but no steel will turn a steam jet.'".
  }
  Event hesta_refuses near hesta when witnessedAttack(hesta, party, hound) "Hesta draws the linen basket to her chest. 'I saw you strike Ash. Find your salve elsewhere.'" then { Assert refusesService(hesta, party). }
  Topic hesta_after with hesta "Speak to Hesta after the fight" when refusesService(hesta, actor) {
    Says "'Nera keeps a shop in town. I will not stop you leaving, but I won't serve you.'".
  }
  Item ward_focus "the warder's copper focus" is warding_focus at workshop.
  Person sentinel "the bronze boiler sentinel" at boiler {
    Role "an abandoned inspection construct". Species bronze_construct. Level 1.
  }
  Observe sentinel_warning at boiler when able(sentinel) "A squat bronze inspector turns on stiff joints. Its plated body resists steel and cannot be poisoned. The arch and pipe walk remain open; nothing compels you to fight it.".
  Item ward_sword "the foundry's Longsword of Flames" is longsword_of_flames at boiler.
  Hazard foundry_steam "Scalding foundry steam" means "Deal (1d6) fire damage to ally unless dexterity save against (11).".
  Thing steam_pipe "the split steam pipe" on boiler_arch {
    State leaking dangerous "A split pipe hisses over the boiler arch. Fresh scorch marks stripe the boiler arch; turning its seized valve needs a crowbar. A fire ward can blunt a scald, but the jet must still be crossed.".
    State shut "The pipe's valve is turned hard shut. The boiler arch is clear.".
    State vented "The old pipe has vented its last pressure. Wet stone steams underfoot.".
    Change close "Turn the steam valve with a bar" from leaking to shut needing crowbar.
    Hurts with foundry_steam when leaking then vented.
  }

  Thing padlock "the stores padlock" on stores_door {
    State locked blocking "A rusted padlock holds the stores door shut.".
    State open "The stores door stands open; its padlock hangs from the hasp.".
    Change pick "Pick the stores padlock" from locked to open needing lockwork.
  }

  Discovery crawl_known "A tram crawl runs from the dry stores to the back of the hoist room; it is marked on a surveyor's board." {
    Source survey_board "a scratched survey board" at vestibule readable by party.
  }

  Observe quay_scene at quay when true "Barges nose into reed-fringed piles. The Serewater is high and brown. Upriver, the derelict foundry on Censer Hill stands above the willows. The Oar's sign creaks over one door, Nera's herbs hang in another, and the shrine porch faces the water.".
  Observe taproom_scene at taproom when true "Dry boots steam above the hearth. Bargemen eat at the long table, and stairs climb to the rooms above.".
  Observe shop_scene at shop_floor when true "Bunches of herbs hang from the beams over shelves of jars, coils of rope and wrapped rations.".
  Observe shrine_scene at shrine when true "Two small altars face each other under a low roof. Water-stained name slips are pinned to every beam.".
  Observe ferry_scene at ferry_room when true "A low kitchen with the tide board nailed by the door and a kettle on the hob.".
  Observe causeway_scene at causeway when true "Old stones run out across the floodplain between willow poles. A track climbs the ridge toward the foundry; a lower path drops into the reeds toward the hill's drain.".
  Observe ridge_scene at ridge when true "Short grass and hawthorn on pale chalk. The foundry yard is just above; Reedwake lies far below.".
  Observe yard_scene at yard when true "Rusting tram rails cross an ash-grown yard. A roofless arch opens into the upper works.".
  Observe drain_scene at drain_mouth when true "A broken culvert breathes cold air out of the hillside. Water already runs ankle-deep along its floor.".
  Observe vestibule_scene at vestibule when true "Lime-washed walls, a fallen lamp bracket, and footprints in the dust heading deeper in.".
  Observe workshop_scene at workshop when true "Half-cast bells lean against the walls. Doorways lead to the stores and the vestibule; steps go down to the casting gallery, and the culvert mouth gapes in the floor.".
  Observe stores_scene at stores when true "Collapsed shelving and oilcloth bundles. The far wall is old brick with a low, black opening at its foot.".
  Observe boiler_scene at boiler when true "A wheel valve and a row of cold boilers fill the room. The workshop arch leads back; a narrow pipe walk reaches the casting gallery.".
  Observe gallery_scene at gallery when true "Ceramic moulds stand in rows beneath a broken roof. The far end narrows into the hoist passage.".
  Observe hoist_scene at hoist when true "A slack cable hangs from the hoist drum. Timber and tools lie where a rack came down.".
  Goal false.
}

  Company party "Your company" of 3 at green.

  }

  Observe cottage_scene at cottage_room when true "Peat smoke, a tally-stick rack by the door, and a window that looks straight up the fell at the quarry.".
  Observe green_scene at green when true "Snow lies thin on the green and thick on the walls. The beck path runs up the valley; a steep track climbs the fellside.".
  Observe lane_scene at lane_foot when true "The beck lane climbs between drystone walls toward the quarry. Snow is already curling over the walls into it.".
  Observe track_scene at fell_track when true "Wind, and a long view of grey fell. The track drops toward the quarry from above.".
  Observe floor_scene at quarry_floor when true "Spoil heaps, a smithy with cold chimney, and the black mouth of the adit in the quarry face.".
  Observe smithy_scene at smithy when true "Tongs, wedges, a cold forge.".
  Observe adit_scene at adit when true "The adit runs straight into the hill. A side drift slopes away to the left.".
  Observe upper_scene at upper_gallery when true "A wide gallery of split slate. In the floor, a square shaft drops into darkness.".
  Observe incline_scene at incline_top when true "Rails run steeply down into the dark: the old tub incline.".
  Observe lower_scene at lower_gallery when true "Low and wet. Rails end in a tangle where an ore tub has jumped them.".

}
